thread:
nina: heads-up: python sdk (v0.4.2) client is sometimes re-emitting the last token after a streaming reconnect. looks like EOF handling in the sse reader differs from node.

joel: ah, node had an explicit EOF delimiter handling landed earlier. can you paste a tiny repro?

nina: minimal repro via curl to /v1/stream/chat (simplified):

```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  \"https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/stream/chat\" -o -
```

Observed chunks (raw):

data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"Th\"}}]}\ndata: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"e\"}}]}\ndata: [DONE]

Socket closes right after DONE. python-sse-reader sometimes sees final 'e' again on reconnect.

priya: in python reader we do readline loops and only consider a full event when we see '\\n\\n'. if socket close splits the last '\\n' off the pending buffer we drop it, then upstream reconnect treats the partial text as new.

joel: that matches. we also had flaky behavior when server sent LF-only vs CRLF. did you try forcing EOF-as-boundary?

nina: I prototyped a change to treat socket close as an implicit '\\n\\n' boundary before processing leftover buffer. quick patch fixed duplicates in my local smoke test.

ci-bot: Issue #4982 created by nina - title: python-sdk: treat EOF as SSE delimiter to avoid duplicate final tokens on reconnect

joel: please add a unit test that simulates recv() returning: [\"data: {...}\\n\", \"data: [DO\", \"NE]\\n\"] (split across calls). tests should also assert no duplication after reconnect.

nina: added test + PR #4128. test simulates split TCP segments + CRLF vs LF variants. also added a small note in sdk/CHANGELOG.md.

ci-bot: PR #4128 merged to main by joel - summary: fix(sdk-python): treat EOF as event terminator for SSE reader; add split-segment tests

priya: awesome. can we also add a sample to the quickstart that highlights best-effort reconnect behavior and idempotency hints for clients? small markdown blurb maybe.

joel: good idea. file dev_docs/quickstart/streaming.md updated in the PR.

nina: verified on staging with the sample app. no more duplicate final tokens and reconnections are cleaner. thanks! :party_popper:
